findings.obligation: brief.md F2: a team's Features tab lists only Features that carry work for that team; feature-delta: estimate above 0 still goes to its team(s)
findings.remediation: Same 0/0 leak remains for estimate >0 smaller than team count: SplitIntoBuckets(1,2) gives [1,0] and AddOrUpdateWorkForTeam(team,0,0) writes a row for the zero-bucket team. Design decision: either skip zero buckets in AssignExtrapolatedWorkToTeams or record it as out-of-scope with a follow-up bug. Not a blocker: the Request names size 0 only.

findings.obligation: brief.md Outcome: Feature not shown on any Team, still shown on Portfolio; feature-delta does not authorise Team Portfolios list changes
findings.remediation: Portfolio.Teams is derived from FeatureWork, and TeamExtensions reads p.Teams to build the Team's Portfolios list. Removing 0/0 rows now drops a Portfolio whose features are all zero-size from every Team's Portfolios list. Record the decision in feature-delta.md (intended or not). Not a blocker.

findings.obligation: feature-delta.md decision 3 and Portfolio-level assignment: a mixed Portfolio where a zero-size Feature precedes a sized Feature changes the sized Feature's fallback team set (WorkItemService.cs:792 portfolio.Teams is now built only from sized rows)
findings.remediation: Add an oracle case with one zero-size and one sized Feature in one Portfolio (no Owning Team, Feature Owner naming a team on the zero-size Feature) and pin the sized Feature's team split. Not a blocker: the Request does not name this case.

findings.obligation: feature-delta.md: no UI change; log warning 'No teams available' is not named as removed
findings.remediation: The early return skips the 'No teams available' warning for size 0 Features. Decide whether a zero-size Feature with no teams should still warn; if not, state it in feature-delta.md. Not a blocker.
